boxes.title: Classification
items: **Geological**: earthquake, landslide, tsunami
**Hydro-meteorological**: cyclone, flood, drought, hailstorm
**Man-made**: ==human activity, negligence, technological failure== (APPSC 2025)
Gas-cylinder fire = **man-made**; nuclear explosion not natural
⚠ Biological: man-made in key; other notes: natural
Notified disasters: **14** since Aug 2026 (+ **heatwave, lightning**); none man-made

boxes.title: Sendai priorities & targets
items: 1 **Understanding disaster risk**; 2 **risk governance**; 3 **investing in DRR**; 4 **preparedness**, ==Build Back Better==
Targets **A-D** reduce: mortality, affected people, economic loss, infrastructure damage
**E** DRR strategies by **2020**; **F** cooperation; **G** early warning
**Voluntary**, non-binding; custodian **UNDRR**

boxes.title: Heat, cold & AP
items: Heatwave: **March to June**; **IMD**; NDMA guidelines updated **2019**
Cold wave: **November to March**; guidelines **2021**; cold day **–4.5°C to –6.4°C**
**Tsunami Ready**: **24 Odisha villages**
AP cyclone stretch: **Ongole** to **Machilipatnam**; worst = **1977 cyclone**
NIDM southern campus: ==**Kondapavuluru**, Krishna== (APPSC 2024)

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: DRR works best when it addresses ==underlying causes of vulnerability== (APPSC 2024)
Post-2015 frameworks: **Sendai, SDGs, Paris**; ⚠ Hyogo NOT one
Bhopal **1984** = **MIC**, Union Carbide
Sendai = **4** priorities, **7** targets; Hyogo = **5** priorities
All three WCDRRs hosted by **Japan**
